method_selected_note: Single change vs incumbent production: AR x R05 overlay combine operator product -> min (max-cash, non-compounding). risk_weight_AR_R05(t) = min(beta_AR(t), beta_R05(t)) replaces beta_AR(t) x beta_R05(t). M4 BOCPD overlay (m4_weight_lag) kept multiplicative in BOTH arms (orthogonal to AR/R05 combine; A/B isolates the single change). base sleeve selection / EW-Iter31-tilt / each beta's own derivation = STR_1715 forward_weights.R unchanged. NOT MVO/HRP/CVaR/ERC weight-search -- regime cash-scaling combine-operator design (sizing_only); Sigma inherited and NOT MVO-consumed (STR_1715 = EW top-N + regime overlay).
selection_objective_note: sizing_only single-change A/B (chain, not sweep -> DSR n/a). Arm NOT selected by optimizer-stage net_ir max (forge authoritative for realized net_ir/SR/MDD). Framing = turnover-adjusted active return: max-cash removes compound over-defense drag while turnover does NOT increase (see turnover_analysis: cash-leg turnover LOWER than incumbent; base churn identical). expected_tracking_error_basis: ex-ante sqrt(w' Sigma w) * sqrt(12) on inherited 18x18 LW Sigma (covariance.parquet, 2026-05-01 holdings basis), best-overlap month 2026-03 (15/18 names). Realized TE = forge-authoritative. Label = estimated_low_confidence.

combine_spec.maxcash_operator: invested(t) = m4_weight_lag(t) * min(beta_AR(t), beta_R05(t))  [AR x R05 = min, non-compounding]

combine_spec.ar_r05_divergence: min != product only when BOTH beta_AR<1 AND beta_R05<1 (co-firing): 32/269 months. Otherwise identical.
